adminEditor.title: Edit and censor image
adminEditor.loadError: The image could not be opened.
adminEditor.canvas: Image preview. Censor zones are shown applied.
adminEditor.lowBlur: A light blur can leave text readable: use pixelate or solid box for sensitive data.

adminEditor.noCensorBody: The project is confidential: the original image will be uploaded with no zone covered.

adminEditor.copyForeign: Only copies of images hosted on this same site can be edited.
adminEditor.selectedN: {{n}} zones selected: changes apply to all.
